name: Swathy G, Tamil Nadu
text: "Mam, I felt like sharing this with you. Initially my 4 year old son was not communicating with other people (than his inner close circle) including to his teacher or friends in school which I found to be too difficult and he was not showing or expressing his skills up to the mark. For this, I don't know what I have to do. People suggested me speech therapists and other classes or therapies for him. This was also one of the reasons for which I took Child psychology, to understand children including my own son too. Now, for the past two months, we could see major changes in him, he started communicating with many people whomever he sees on the road and his school teacher also praised him on his academics and his communication towards others. Though there are certain things which still he needs to change, I am happy and understood that this too will happen soon. This positive effect in me or thinking in me is all because of you and Mandovi mam. Both of you have changed my approach to handling my child and also taught me how to make him understand things. Thank you very much mam. Convey my thanks to Mandovi mam too, her classes also helped me in practical solutions for certain things. Though I have learnt only a small portion, this boosts me up to study further and improve my career too. Thank you again mam."
